scope: Generated AC1027 DWG LIGHT hotspot and falloff conversion in dwg2dxf after a caller-explicit replacement of unqualified DWG CMC metadata. Not a whole-file, native-rendering, or LIGHT-support qualification.
sources: LibreDWG src/dwg2.spec LIGHT fields hotspot_angle and falloff_angle are BD groups 50 and 51; src/out_dxf.c VALUE_BD converts groups 50-54 from radians to degrees.
oda_scope: The supplied ODA v5.4.1 text search did not locate a LIGHT class-specific schema; no ODA class layout proof is claimed.

reproduction.source: Locally generated AC1027, class LIGHT, hotspot 0.25 and falloff 0.75 in the DWG bit-double fields. Not a committed fixture.
reproduction.peer: LibreDWG 0.14 emitted group 50 = 14.32394487827058 and group 51 = 42.97183463481174; its conversion warned of an invalid handle offset and an unresolved handle. The observation is limited to these fields and does not qualify the source file.
reproduction.before: The public DWG callback returned 0.25 and 0.75, and a directly passed representable LIGHT writer emitted those as DXF degrees.
reproduction.after: The converter retains a sealed source-read token on each DWG LIGHT, projects angles on an output copy only, and continues to pass DXF-origin degrees unchanged. Unsupported source versions and invalid or failed provenance refuse output.

validation.result: 1/1 passed for generated DWG and ASCII/Binary DXF, raw-radian callback, refusal of untouched DWG CMC, explicit ACI edit and retry, mixed origins, later DXF import and document generation changes, repeated export, source edits, exact-address replacement, invalid numeric values and provenance, destination preservation, and retry.
